policy.auxiliary_embedded_rule: At each original { character, JSONDecoder.raw_decode locates a complete object; its exact unchanged substring must pass the frozen structural parser. No character repair, fence removal or schema relaxation.
policy.auxiliary_whole_reasoning_rule: The complete original reasoning string must pass the frozen structural parser.
policy.full_answer_uniqueness: Canonical JSON of all seven fields including rationale; repeated identical objects count as one answer. Multiple different valid objects are ambiguous and not treated as recoverable.
policy.primary_content_normalization: The unchanged runner preserves string content, joins text blocks, and maps missing/other content to an empty string before structural parsing; content=None therefore produces the observed char 0 JSONDecodeError.
policy.primary_failure_rule: Missing/invalid content remains failed in the original 800-item headline denominator. No reasoning fallback, extraction, repair, relabeling or rescoring is applied.
policy.six_label_ambiguity: Canonical six label fields excluding rationale, reported separately.
